map.→ 打开爬升率 (ROC)工具: -> Open the rate of climb (ROC) tool
map.为什么高空爬升率会下降？: Why does the climb rate fall at high altitude?
map.判断飞机能否在限定的越障梯度上爬升，用于起飞越障评估。: Judges whether an aircraft can climb a given obstacle clearance gradient, for takeoff obstacle clearance assessment.
map.发动机功率/推力随空气密度下降而降低，所需功率随真速上升，可用盈余被压缩，故爬升: Engine power or thrust falls with air density and the required power rises with true airspeed, so the margin is squeezed, which is why the climb rate first rises then falls with altitude and a theoretical absolute ceiling exists.
map.可用功率盈余的爬升率: The climb rate available from the power margin
map.多余功率决定爬升率。: The surplus power determines the climb rate.
map.对比不同高度（功率随高度衰减）的爬升率，找最佳爬升速度。: Compare climb rates at different altitudes (power falls with altitude) to find the best climb speed.
map.性能核算中，由可用功率 Pa 与所需功率 Ps 之差、重量 W，算爬升率 ROC: In performance accounting the climb rate is ROC=(Pa−Ps)/W, from the difference between available power Pa and required power Ps, divided by weight W.
map.根据剩余功率（推力减阻力乘速度）计算爬升率 ROC，评估航空器上升性能，适用于飞: Computes the climb rate ROC from the surplus power (thrust minus drag times speed), evaluating aircraft climb performance for flight performance analysis, trajectory planning and takeoff climb checks.
map.爬升率单位常看到 ft/min 怎么换算？: How do I convert the climb rate unit often seen in ft/min?
map.由动压、阻力系数与面积求阻力: Drag from dynamic pressure, drag coefficient and area
map.由空气密度与速度求动压: Dynamic pressure from air density and velocity
map.：可用功率 Pa=2000 kW、所需功率 Ps=1800 kW、重量 W=60: : available power Pa=2000 kW, required power Ps=1800 kW, weight W=600000 N. Power surplus=200000 W, ROC = 200000/600000 = 0.333 m/s = 1200 m/h. That is about 0.33 metres of climb per second.
